s: fkAraH । saptamasvaravarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM mUrdDA । (fwurazARAmmUrdDA” । ityukteH । taTAca SikzAyAM “syurmUrdDaRyA fwurazAH” । taTA ca mugDaboDe । “ftrayaM waWaqaQaRarazA mUrdDaRyAH” । iti .) sa tu hrasvo dIrGaH plutaSca Bavati ॥ (evaM triDApi udAttAnudAttasaritaBedAt navaviDastataH pratyekaM anunAsikAnunAsikaBedAdazwAdaSaviDaeva .) “fkAraM parameSAni kuRqalI mUrttimAn svayam । atra brahmA ca vizRuSca rudraScEva varAnane ॥ sadASivayutaM varRaM sadA ISvarasaMyutam । paYcavarRamayaM varRaM caturjYAnamayaM taTA ॥ raktavidyullatAkAraM fkAraM praRamAmyaham” ॥ iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ (vaNgIyaBAzAyAm) tasya leKanaprakArAdi yaTA । “UrdDvAddakzagatA vakrA trikoRA vAmatastataH । punastvaDodakzagatA mAtrA SaktiH parA smftA ॥ mAtrAsu brahmavizwvISAstizWanti kramataH parAH” । iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ tasya nAmAni yaTA । “fH pUrdIrGamuKI rudro devamAtA trivikramaH । BAvaBUtiH kriyA krUrA recikA nASikA DftaH ॥ ekapAdaSiro mAlA maRqalA SAntinI jalam । karRaH kAmalatA meDo nivfttirgaRanAyakaH ॥ rohiRI SivadUtI ca pUrRagiriSca saptamI” । iti tantram ॥ (mAtfkAnyAse'sya dakziRaGrARe'vasTititvAttadAKyayApyaBiDAnam । yaTA, mAtfkAnyAsaDftamantre “fM namo dakziRaGrARe FM namo vAmaGrARe” । iti । anubanDaviSezaH । yaTA, kavikalpadrumaH । “uH ktvAveqastu vewka fH । caNya-hrasvaH” । etena QOkfN gatyAmityasya luNi aquQOkaditi sidDam ॥)
prApe । gatyAm । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAdiMparaM-sakaM-aniw .) prApaH prAptiH । “fcCati DanaM kftI” । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ra li gatyAm । (juho-para-saka-aniw .) ra vEdikaH । li iyartti । Sapo lukvaraRAdasya SatfSAnayoreva fcCAdeSaH । iyfcCat samiyfcCAnaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ra na hiMsane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (svAM-paraMsakaM-aniw .) ra vEdikaH । na fRoti । rePAdistftIyasvarAnto'yamiti kecit । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
vya garhaRam । vAkyam । devamAtari strI । iti medinI ॥ (samboDanam .) parihAsaH । vAkyavikAraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (puM, svargaH ॥)
v: fkAraH svaravarRRaBedaH mUrdDanyaH “fwurazARAM murdDA” ityukteH । sa tu udAttAnudAttasvaritaBedAt triviDaH । anunAsikAnanunAsikaBedAt pratyekaM dviDeti zaqviDaH । sa ca hrasvaH ekamAtrAkAlenocAryyatvAt । tasya ca ruktavidyullatArUpeRa DyeyatoktA । “raktavidyullatAkAramfkAraM praRamAmya ham” kAma॰ ta॰ । tasya ca mAtfkAnyAse vAmanAsikAyAM nyasyatA uktA tena aBedopacArAt vAmanAsAdiSabdavAcyatA । svarUpaparatve tataH takArakArapratyayO ft fkAraH tatkAlocAryye “taparastatkAlasyEva” pA॰ ukteH । vyakaraRaSAstre ananubanDaH f ityetat azwAdaSaviDasya fvarRRasya, dvAdaSaviDasya xkArasya saMjYA Bavati tena “f iti triMSatAM saMjYA” iti si॰ kO॰ । aDikaM svaravarRAdiSabdasamAptO vakzyate samAnavarRRagrahaRadyotanArTam varRaSabdottaraH prayujyate fvarRaH triMSatAM saMjYA ।

gatO BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ aniwa । Siti fcCAdeSaH । fcCati ArcCat Arat--ArzIt । Ara AriTa arttA aryyAt arizyati । Arizyan । fcCan ftaH ftiH arttavyaH araRIyaH aryyaH yat vESyasvAminoH anyatra Ryat AryyaH । arttA ArI ArivAn arttum । saNgamArTatvenAkarmmakAt sampUrvvakAt tataH Atma॰ । samfcCate । samArata samArtta । “sAramAnavarArohA--vanamAra sA” udBawaH । f--Ric arpayati te । san aririzati samaririzate gatyarTatve'pi kOwilye yaN । arAryyate “kimaBIrurarAryyase” BawwiH । karmaRi aryyate । Ari ।

gatO prApaRe ca juho॰ para॰ saka॰ aniw । laqAdO Sapoluktvena SitparatvABAvAt na fcCAdeSaH । SatfSAnacostutadAdeSaH । iyartti iyftaH iyrati । iyfyAt । iyarttu iyfhi iyarARi । EyaH EyftAm EyaruH । Arat--ArzIt sfsAhacaryyAt aNviDO BvAdereva grahaRamityanye tanmate ArzIdityeva । samArata samArtta ityanye Ara ityAdi BvAdivat । SittvAt iyfcCan samfcCAna iti BedaH । ayaM vEdika eveti bahavaH “bahulaM CandasIti” pA॰ sidDeH “arttipipArttyoSca” pA॰ itIttvaviDAnasAmarTyAdayaM BAzAyAmapi” si॰ kO॰ । “Suzma iyartti praBfto me adri” f॰ 1, 165, 4 । “iyartti vAcamariteva nAvam” 2, 42, 1 । anayorgatyarTatvAt upasargaBedenArTaBedastu iRaDAtuvat sa ca tacCabde uktaH “aBEzuH kapayo'nvArat kumBakarRaM marutsutaH” “sItAM jiGAMsU sOmitre rAkzasAvAratAM Druvam” BawwiH । A + fta ArttaH vfdDiH “taTArtto'pi kriyAM DarmyAm” BawwiH “udayarzi BAnunA” f॰10, 140, 2, “samudrAdUrmimudiyartti venaH” 10, 123, 3, “yadA SasA niHSasA BiSasopArima jAgrato yat svapantaH” f॰10, 164, 3, evaM yaTAyaTamupasargapUrvasya udAharaRaM dfSyam ।

hiMsAyAM svA॰ para॰ saka॰ aniw । fRoti । fRuyAta fRotu fRu ArRat । ArzIt liqAdO BvAdivat Satf--fRvan kta fRam itiBedaH “tvezasteDUma fRvati” f॰6, 2, 6, “fRaM deyamadeyaYca yena yatra yaTA ca yat” yAjYa॰ smftiH । “apadvArA matInAM pratnA fRvanti kA ravaH” f॰ 9, 10, 6, fRorakzaM na SacIBiH” f॰ 1, 30, 15, asya rikArAditvamityanye riRoti ityAdi ।

“fHsudIrGamuKI rudrodevamAtA trivikramaH । BAraBUtiH kriyA hArorecikA nAsikA DftiH । ekapAdaH SiromAlA maRqanA SAntinI jalam । karRaH kAmalatA meGonivfttirgaRanAyakaH । rohiRI SivadUvI ca pUrRRA giriSca saptamI” ।

“fkAraM parameSAni kuRqalImUrttiDArakam । atra vrahmA ca vizRuSca rudraScEva varAnane! । sadASivamayaM varRaM sadAISvarasaMyutam । paYcavarRamaya varRaMcaturjYAnamayaM taTA । rakta vidyullatAkAramUkAraM praRamAmyaham ।
m: 1. ऋ the seventh vowel of the Sanskṛt alphabet and peculiar to it (resembling the sound of ri in merrily).
2. ऋ ind. an interjection expressing laughter, L.
a sound inarticulate or reiterated as in stammering, W.
ऋ f. N. of Aditi, L.

4. ऋ cl. 1. 3. 5.P. ऋच्छति, इयर्ति, ऋणोति, and ऋण्वति (only Ved.); आर, अरिष्यति, आरत्, and आर्षीत्, to go, move, rise, tend upwards, RV.; Nir. &c.; to go towards, meet with, fall upon or into, reach, obtain, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.; to fall to one's share, occur, befall (with acc.), RV.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.; to advance towards a foe, attack, invade, ŚBr.; MBh.; Mn.; to hurt, offend, ŚBr. vii; to move, excite, erect, raise, (इयर्ति वाचम्, he raises his voice, RV. ii, 42, 2; स्तोमान् इयर्मि, I sing hymns, RV. i, 116, 1), RV.; AV. vi, 22, 3 : Caus. अर्पयति, to cause to move, throw, cast, AV. x, 9, 1; Ragh. &c.; to cast through, pierce, AV.; to put in or upon, place, insert, fix into or upon, fasten, RV.; Śāk.; Kum.; Bhag. &c.; to place on, apply, Kathās.; Ratnāv.; Ragh. &c.; to direct or turn towards, R.; Bhag. &c.; to deliver up, surrender, offer, reach over, present, give, Yājñ.; Pañcat.; Vikr. &c.; to give back, restore, Mn. viii, 191; Yājñ.; Śak. &c.: Ved. Intens. अलर्ति, RV. viii, 48, 8; (2. sg. अलर्षि, RV. viii, 1, 7; Pāṇ. vii, 4, 65); to move or go towards with speed or zeal: Class. Intens. Ā. अरार्यते (Pāṇ. vii, 4, 30), to wander about, hasten towards, Bhaṭṭ.; Pat., Kāś.;
ऋ [cf. Gk. ὄρ-νυ-μι, ἐρ-έ-της, ἀρό-ω, &c. : Zend √ ir : Lat. or-ior, re-mus, aro : Goth. ar-gan : Angl.Sax. ār : Old High Germ. ruo-dar, ar-an : Lith. ir-ti, ‘to row’; ar-ti, ‘to plough’.]
a: ऋ — ind. An interjection of(1) calling; (2) ridicule; (3) censure or abuse; (4) used at the beginning of a sentence.

ऋ — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (ऋच्छति, आर, आर्षीत्, अरिष्यति, ऋत; caus. अर्पयति; desid. अरिरिषति) 1 To go, move; अंभश्छायामच्छामृच्छति Śi. 4. 44. --2 To rise, tend towards. {vII.v} {c3c} P. (इयर्ति, आरत्, ऋत) (Mostly used in the Veda) 1 To go. --2 To move, shake. --3 To obtain, gain, acquire, reach, meet with. --4 To move, excite, raise (as voice, words &c.) वाचमियर्ति. --5 To display. {vIII.v} {c5c} P. (ऋणोति, ऋण) 1 To injure, hurt. --2 To attack. --Caus. (अर्पयति, आर्पिपत्, अर्पित) 1 To throw, cast, fling; fix or implant in; हृदि शल्यमर्पितं R. 8. 87. --2 To put or place on, fix upon, direct or cast towards (as the eye &c.); वामप्रकोष्ठार्पितहेमवेत्रः Ku. 3. 41; Ś. 6. 5, 17, 3. 26; R. 17. 79; Ś. 6. 8; Bk. 5. 90; Ku. 6. 11; R. 15. 77; Bg. 8. 7, 12. 14; करपल्लवार्पित Śi. 9. 54. --3 To place in, insert, give, set or place; अपथे पदमर्पयंति हि R. 9. 74, 78; चित्रार्पितां Ś. 6. 15 drawn in a picture; R. 2. 31; द्वारदेशे Amaru. 62; V. 4. 35; Mu. 7. 6; Bh. 3. 18; लोकोत्तरं चरितमर्पयति प्रतिष्ठां R. G. --4 To hand or make over, give to, give in charge of, consign, deliver; इति सूतस्याभरणान्यर्पयति Ś. 1, 4. 19; Bk. 8. 118; Y. 2. 65. --5 To give up, sacrifice (as the inherent sense); अत्र कलिंगगंगाशब्दौ आत्मानमर्पयतः S. D. 2. --6 To give back, restore; R. 19. 10; Bk. 15. 16; Amaru. 94; Ms. 8. 191; Y. 2. 169. --7 To pierce through, perforate, penetrate.
